subject: english-literature
title: Supporting Cast Quest
welcome_lead: Behind every hero stands a circle of voices that shape the tale.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on supporting characters and dynamics.
final_note: You can now map the people who orbit the protagonist.

concepts.def: Not the lead but helps the plot.
A character who contrasts the hero.

walkthroughs.body_html: A foil highlights traits in another character. In Sherlock Holmes, Watson's ordinariness highlights Sherlock's genius.
A round character has contradictions and depth. A flat character has one defining trait, useful for minor roles.
Dynamic characters grow (Scrooge in A Christmas Carol). Static characters do not change, often providing stability.
